description: A compact intimate alt-R&B song about standing at the edge of return, where a key carries fragile agency and the room feels both safe and dangerous.
style_of_music: Slow nocturnal alt-R&B, downtempo ambient pop, 82 BPM, 4/4, sparse piano, close restrained vocal, low sub pressure, rain-like texture, unresolved harmony, intimate dry vocal against distant room tone, compact two-minute structure, quiet-to-restrained lift, unresolved final return.

sonic_concept_summary.primary_sonic_concept: a close nocturnal song where room tone, breath, and piano hold an unresolved threshold
sonic_concept_summary.target_sonic_engine: sparse piano motif, close vocal, low sub pressure, rain texture, unresolved chord extensions

genre_conflicts.conflict: Alt-R&B warmth could over-resolve the grief.
genre_conflicts.adaptation: Keep the vocal warm but hold harmony unresolved and leave negative space around the pulse.

tempo_groove_summary.tempo_stability: steady pulse with slight perceived drag

vocal_lyric_policy.vocal_direction: close restrained lead vocal, almost-whispered verses, clearer chorus with light doubling
vocal_lyric_policy.rights_notes: New lyrics drafted from the brief; do not copy source text verbatim.

lyrics.title: Where the Light Ends
lyrics.text:
[Verse]
I came back quiet to the step I knew
The room was warm but it would not move
I held the metal like it had a heart
Too small to keep, too scared to start

[Chorus]
Where the light ends, I am almost home
Where the light ends, I am still alone
If I turn the key, I lose the door
If I walk away, I keep it more

arrangement_plan.instructions: Build a compact two-minute song with sparse intro, restrained verse, tightening pre-chorus, unresolved chorus, exposed bridge, and a final hook that fades into room tone.
arrangement_plan.dynamic_arc: quiet invitation, tightening build, restrained release, exposed rupture, unresolved return
arrangement_plan.ending_behavior: end on an unresolved piano fragment and room tone

sections.tension_role: establish the room without resolving it

production_direction.mix_perspective: close vocal in front, distant room texture behind
production_direction.space_reverb: dry intimate vocal with reverberant piano tails
production_direction.texture: soft noise, low pressure, rain-like motion

sonic_dynamics_summary.name: Sparse / Dense
evidence: few details carry most of the emotional weight

sonic_dynamics_summary.name: Soft / Loud
evidence: the scene is still and restrained
translation_notes: Keep the vocal close and quiet.

sonic_dynamics_summary.name: Dry / Reverberant
evidence: intimate threshold and active room memory
translation_notes: Keep vocal dry; let piano tails carry space.

sonic_dynamics_summary.name: Consonant / Dissonant
translation_notes: Use tender chords with unresolved extensions.

sonic_differentiators: balanced sparse alt-R&B arrangement with piano, vocal, low sub, and minimal percussion
clear hook while preserving unresolved harmony
prompt_variants.prompt_text: Create a compact two-minute nocturnal alt-R&B song at about 82 BPM in 4/4. Use sparse felt piano, close restrained lead vocal, low sub pressure, soft rain-like noise, and unresolved chord extensions. Keep the verses almost whispered and the chorus clearer but not triumphant. Use the provided lyrics and preserve the feeling of standing at a threshold where return is tender and dangerous.
